activations.domainDescription: Real-time sensing of internal bodily states during practice
activations.domainFunction: Monitors breath, heartbeat, gut sensation, and proprioceptive signals as primary meditation objects
activations.whyThisNode: Anterior insula is the brain's primary interoceptive hub — it thickens measurably with contemplative practice (Lazar et al. 2005)

treatments.label: Graded interoceptive exposure
treatments.description: Titrate body-awareness practices from neutral zones to challenging areas, building tolerance progressively

treatments.label: Body-scan calibration assessment
treatments.description: Map interoceptive sensitivity across body regions to identify hyper- and hypo-aware zones

activations.domainDescription: Conflict monitoring and sustained attention regulation in practice
activations.domainFunction: Detects mind-wandering, flags distractions, and recruits corrective focus back to the meditation object
activations.whyThisNode: Dorsal ACC is the conflict monitor that fires when attention drifts — the neural basis of noticing distraction in meditation

treatments.label: Focused attention scaffolding
treatments.description: Begin with short 5-minute sits using counting breaths, gradually extend duration as stability builds

treatments.label: Attentional stability assessment
treatments.description: Track breath-count accuracy and distraction frequency over sessions to quantify attentional capacity

activations.domainDescription: Narrative self, mind-wandering, and autobiographical rumination
activations.domainFunction: Generates the ongoing stream of self-referential thought that meditation practices aim to observe or quiet
activations.whyThisNode: DMN suppression is the most replicated finding across all meditation neuroimaging — it quiets in experienced meditators even at rest (Brewer et al. 2011)

treatments.label: Noting practice protocol
treatments.description: Label thought-streams as 'thinking' without engaging content to decouple identification from DMN output

treatments.label: DMN reactivity mapping
treatments.description: Identify specific self-referential themes (regret, planning, identity) that hijack attention most frequently

activations.domainDescription: Medial prefrontal representation of the self-concept in practice
activations.domainFunction: Maintains the sense of a continuous self that contemplative practice gradually loosens or transforms
activations.whyThisNode: mPFC is the core DMN hub for self-referential processing — its deactivation correlates with ego dissolution experiences

treatments.label: Graded self-inquiry protocol
treatments.description: Progressive self-inquiry from biographical to phenomenological to non-dual, with teacher guidance at each stage

treatments.label: Self-concept stability screening
treatments.description: Assess ego-integrity before intensive retreat practice to identify vulnerability to destabilization

activations.domainDescription: Posterior cingulate processing of self-relevance and attachment
activations.domainFunction: Evaluates how personally relevant or 'mine' an experience feels — the grasping function that practice loosens
activations.whyThisNode: PCC deactivation tracks with the felt sense of 'letting go' in meditation — it anchors the sense of self-as-experiencer

treatments.label: Non-attachment cultivation
treatments.description: Practice observing pleasant and unpleasant sensations with equanimity, reducing PCC grasping response

treatments.label: Attachment pattern assessment
treatments.description: Map which experience types trigger strongest grasping or aversion reactions during sits

activations.domainDescription: Top-down attentional control and working memory in practice
activations.domainFunction: Maintains the intention to meditate, holds instructions in working memory, and executes deliberate attention shifts
activations.whyThisNode: dlPFC is heavily recruited in early-stage focused attention practice, then progressively less needed as practice deepens

treatments.label: Concentration-to-openness progression
treatments.description: Structured transition from focused attention (high dlPFC) to open monitoring (low dlPFC) across months of practice

treatments.label: Executive load assessment
treatments.description: Evaluate whether practitioner is over-efforting via dlPFC strain versus allowing natural awareness

activations.domainDescription: Evaluation of emotional significance and fear extinction in practice
activations.domainFunction: Processes the emotional meaning of arising experiences and supports fear extinction through repeated safe exposure
activations.whyThisNode: vmPFC mediates fear extinction and emotional reappraisal — key to how meditation reduces threat-reactivity over time

treatments.label: Compassion-based emotional regulation
treatments.description: Cultivate metta and self-compassion to strengthen vmPFC regulatory capacity over amygdala reactivity

treatments.label: Emotional trigger mapping
treatments.description: Identify recurrent emotional themes arising in practice that overwhelm regulatory capacity

activations.domainDescription: Amygdala reactivity to perceived threats arising during practice
activations.domainFunction: Generates fear and threat responses to memories, sensations, or states that emerge during deep practice
activations.whyThisNode: Amygdala reactivity decreases with meditation practice duration (Desbordes et al. 2012) — a core mechanism of contemplative benefit

treatments.label: Trauma-sensitive meditation protocol
treatments.description: Modified practice with eyes open, choice of posture, and permission to stop — prevents amygdala flooding

treatments.label: Threat reactivity screening
treatments.description: Pre-retreat assessment of trauma history and amygdala reactivity to determine practice modifications needed

activations.domainDescription: Serotonin system modulation through sustained practice
activations.domainFunction: Regulates mood baseline, equanimity, and the sense of well-being that deepens with regular practice
activations.whyThisNode: Raphe serotonin output increases with meditation practice — serotonin underlies the equanimity and mood stability cultivated

treatments.label: Consistent daily practice schedule
treatments.description: Establish twice-daily 20-minute practice rhythm to build stable serotonergic tone over weeks

treatments.label: Mood baseline tracking
treatments.description: Track pre- and post-sit mood states over 30 days to quantify serotonergic benefit trajectory

activations.domainDescription: Thalamic filtering of sensory input during contemplative states
activations.domainFunction: Modulates the flow of sensory information to cortex — either reducing external input (absorption) or enhancing it (open monitoring)
activations.whyThisNode: Thalamus controls the gate between external sensation and conscious awareness — its modulation defines different meditation states

treatments.label: Sensory grounding anchors
treatments.description: Use external sensory anchors (sound, touch) when internal practice triggers dissociative gating shutdown

treatments.label: Absorption depth monitoring
treatments.description: Track loss of external awareness during sits to detect unhealthy dissociative versus healthy absorptive states

activations.domainDescription: Hippocampal processing of autobiographical memories during practice
activations.domainFunction: Retrieves and reconsolidates memories that arise during meditation, enabling new emotional contexts for old material
activations.whyThisNode: Hippocampal theta during meditation facilitates memory reconsolidation — a mechanism for processing traumatic material safely

treatments.label: Integration journaling protocol
treatments.description: Post-sit journaling to process autobiographical material that emerged, supporting reconsolidation

treatments.label: Memory intrusion frequency tracking
treatments.description: Monitor frequency and intensity of unbidden memory content during practice to detect overwhelm risk

activations.domainDescription: Switching between internal and external attention modes
activations.domainFunction: Toggles between task-positive and default mode networks — the switch that contemplative practice trains
activations.whyThisNode: Salience network mediates the switch between DMN and ECN — meditation trains this switching capacity, improving attentional flexibility

treatments.label: Alternating practice modes
treatments.description: Alternate focused attention and open monitoring within sessions to exercise salience network flexibility

treatments.label: Network switching assessment
treatments.description: Evaluate ease of transitioning between practice styles to gauge salience network health

crossDomainAffinities.role: Anticipatory Anxiety Generator — Adaptation & Self-Healing — Secondary Node

activations.domainDescription: Somatosensory processing of body sensation in practice
activations.domainFunction: Processes the body-level sensations that form the primary objects of many contemplative practices
activations.whyThisNode: Somatomotor network thickens in long-term Zen practitioners (Grant et al. 2010) — body awareness is a core contemplative skill

treatments.label: Progressive body scanning protocol
treatments.description: Systematic sweeping attention through body regions to develop granular somatic awareness

treatments.label: Somatic distress screening
treatments.description: Screen for unusual somatic phenomena (energy surges, involuntary movement) that indicate kundalini-type activation

activations.domainDescription: Brainwave entrainment and coherence during practice
activations.domainFunction: Generates and coordinates the alpha, theta, and gamma oscillations that characterize different contemplative states
activations.whyThisNode: Gamma coherence increases dramatically in experienced meditators (Lutz et al. 2004) — oscillations are the signature of contemplative state shifts

treatments.label: Rhythmic practice foundations
treatments.description: Use mantra, chanting, or breath-counting to entrain stable oscillatory patterns as foundation for deeper practice

treatments.label: EEG neurofeedback integration
treatments.description: Optional neurofeedback to verify alpha-theta crossover and gamma coherence during practice sessions

activations.domainDescription: BDNF-mediated structural brain changes from sustained practice
activations.domainFunction: Drives the cortical thickening and synaptic remodeling that encodes contemplative skills as lasting neural changes
activations.whyThisNode: BDNF is the molecular mechanism behind meditation-induced cortical thickening and enhanced connectivity (Cahn et al. 2017)

treatments.label: Long-term practice commitment
treatments.description: Sustained daily practice over months to years is required for BDNF-mediated structural changes to consolidate

treatments.label: Complementary aerobic exercise
treatments.description: Regular aerobic exercise synergistically boosts BDNF alongside contemplative practice

activations.domainDescription: Ventral vagal complex regulating rest-and-digest during practice
activations.domainFunction: Activates the parasympathetic calming response that deepens with breath-focused and compassion practices
activations.whyThisNode: Vagal tone (HRV) increases significantly with metta and breath meditation (Kok et al. 2013) — the body's calming axis

treatments.label: Resonant frequency breathing
treatments.description: Breath at 5.5 breaths per minute to maximize vagal tone and HRV — immediate physiological calming

treatments.label: HRV baseline tracking
treatments.description: Track resting HRV over weeks to quantify autonomic benefit of contemplative practice

activations.domainDescription: Self-other boundary processing in compassion practices
activations.domainFunction: Enables the shift from self-focused to other-focused awareness in metta and tonglen practices
activations.whyThisNode: TPJ activates strongly in loving-kindness meditation (Klimecki et al. 2014) — it mediates the self-other boundary critical to compassion

treatments.label: Compassion practice progression
treatments.description: Structured metta from self to loved ones to neutral to difficult persons, building TPJ capacity progressively

treatments.label: Self-other boundary assessment
treatments.description: Evaluate whether practitioner maintains healthy self-other distinction versus merger or disconnection

activations.domainDescription: First-person spatial perspective and self-consciousness
activations.domainFunction: Maintains the spatial sense of being a located observer — disrupted in ego-dissolution and unitive experiences
activations.whyThisNode: Precuneus deactivation correlates with self-boundary dissolution in deep meditation and psilocybin states

treatments.label: Grounding after deep sits
treatments.description: Walking meditation or body movement after deep absorption to re-engage spatial self-awareness safely

treatments.label: Depersonalization screening
treatments.description: Screen for persistent depersonalization or derealization outside of formal practice sessions

activations.domainDescription: Pain modulation and endorphin release during sustained practice
activations.domainFunction: Mediates the pain tolerance and endogenous opioid release that occurs in sustained sitting and breathwork
activations.whyThisNode: Zen meditators show increased pain tolerance mediated through PAG — they process pain without the suffering overlay (Grant et al. 2011)

treatments.label: Pain reappraisal training
treatments.description: Practice observing pain sensation as impersonal process rather than threat, engaging PAG-mediated analgesic response

treatments.label: Posture and pain assessment
treatments.description: Distinguish between healthy postural discomfort and pathological pain requiring medical attention

activations.domainDescription: Locus coeruleus noradrenergic modulation during practice
activations.domainFunction: Regulates alertness level — balancing the alert wakefulness needed for practice against drowsiness and agitation
activations.whyThisNode: LC norepinephrine output modulates the alert-calm balance that contemplative practice optimizes — neither agitated nor dull

treatments.label: Arousal calibration techniques
treatments.description: Use breath rate and posture adjustments to find optimal arousal: upright and alert without tension

treatments.label: Drowsiness versus agitation tracking
treatments.description: Track ratio of dull versus agitated sits to calibrate practice intensity and timing

issues.label: Chronic Rumination
issues.summary: Persistent self-referential thought loops that meditation fails to interrupt or paradoxically intensifies

circuits.detail: dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control — rigidity/rumination-lock

_authored.detail: Default mode network remains hyperactive during practice — mind-wandering dominates despite effort to focus
Self-referential processing loop cannot be disrupted — narrative self maintains constant commentary
Experiential grasping intensifies as practitioner fights to stop thinking, creating meta-rumination
Conflict monitoring detects wandering but cannot recruit enough attentional control to redirect
Low serotonergic baseline undermines equanimity needed to observe thoughts without engagement
Executive attention exhausted from repeated failed attempts to control thought stream

issues.label: Meditation-Induced Dissociation
issues.summary: Practice triggers depersonalization, derealization, or emotional numbing rather than healthy equanimity

_authored.detail: Thalamic sensory gate closes too far — external reality becomes unreal or distant during and after practice
Spatial self-awareness collapses — practitioner loses sense of body location and self-as-observer
Interoceptive awareness disconnects — body sensations become remote or absent rather than vivid
Default mode coherence disrupted rather than quieted — self-continuity breaks down pathologically
Somatic awareness network goes offline — numbness rather than refined sensitivity
Salience network fails to switch between internal and external modes appropriately

issues.label: Attention Instability
issues.summary: Inability to sustain focused attention or open awareness despite consistent practice effort

circuits.detail: dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control — executive-lapse, distractible

_authored.detail: Conflict monitoring too weak to detect mind-wandering in real time — drift goes unnoticed for minutes
Executive attention cannot maintain focus for more than seconds before losing the meditation object
Salience network triggers on every minor stimulus, constantly pulling attention to irrelevant signals
Alpha and theta oscillations fail to stabilize — no consistent brainwave pattern for sustained attention
Arousal oscillates between drowsiness and agitation — cannot find stable alertness for practice

issues.label: Emotional Flooding in Practice
issues.summary: Practice surfaces overwhelming emotions — grief, terror, rage — that exceed the practitioner's regulatory capacity

_authored.detail: Amygdala fires intensely as meditation removes habitual suppression of traumatic emotional material
Emotional regulation capacity overwhelmed — prefrontal control cannot contain limbic activation
Hippocampus floods awareness with traumatic autobiographical memories during vulnerable practice states
Vagal tone drops — parasympathetic calming fails, sympathetic fight-flight takes over during sits
Serotonergic system cannot maintain equanimity baseline under extreme emotional activation
Self-relevance processing amplifies emotional content — everything feels deeply personally threatening

issues.label: Spiritual Emergency
issues.summary: Rapid ego dissolution, mystical states, or dark-night experiences that destabilize psychological functioning

circuits.detail: posterior cingulate — DMN internal-focus hub — dissociation from self

_authored.detail: Self-model disintegrates — practitioner loses coherent sense of identity outside of formal practice
Spatial self-awareness persistently disrupted — ongoing derealization and boundary dissolution
Default mode network coherence shattered — the narrative self cannot reconstitute between sessions
Existential terror as ego structures dissolve — fear without object, pervasive dread
Self-other boundary lost — confusion about what is self and what is other, empathic overwhelm
Autobiographical continuity disrupted — past self feels unreal or disconnected from present experience

issues.label: Somatic Distress / Kundalini Syndrome
issues.summary: Intense physical symptoms — energy surges, involuntary movements, heat, pain — arising from practice

_authored.detail: Interoceptive awareness amplified beyond tolerance — every body sensation becomes overwhelming
Somatomotor network generates involuntary movements, kriyas, trembling, or jerking during practice
Analgesic system alternates between pain suppression and breakthrough — unpredictable somatic pain
Autonomic nervous system oscillates wildly — heat flashes, heart racing, then sudden calm
Sensory gating distorted — internal sensations amplified while external reality dims
Noradrenergic system in overdrive — persistent hyper-arousal, insomnia, and energy surges between sessions
